messages:
Maya: Quick q — if we toggle the structured-output compat flag on Hosted, what should clients that don't understand function-calling see? Hard errors or a safe fallback?
Ashwin: We expose a compat flag `so_structured_output_v1`. Clients that don't opt in get the old text blob — no hard errors, just no structured fields.
Luke: FYI older mobile SDKs (<= 0.9.2) assume plain text. They should ignore unknown fields but might choke on changed shapes. Recommend excluding those versions from canary.
Sarah: Agree. Proposed audiences: 5% web, 2% backend services. Also we should push `so_parse_hint` opt-in in SDKs first.
Maya: Can we gate in the router by SDK version header? e.g., `client_version < 0.9.3` -> compat=false routing?
Ashwin: Yes — routing supports header/semver rules. I'll add `x-rw-client` semver check to the canary config.
Deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Applied routing rule `so-compat-routing` to canary set | 1918204000
Kevin: :thumbsup: Which telemetry should we watch closely?
Nora: Add events: `so.enabled` (bool), `so.version`, `client_sdk_version`, `parse_errors`. Also track `tokens_per_request` and `latency_p50/p90`.
Luke: Also queue a small eval run comparing `structured_parse_accuracy` vs `text_match_score` for our canonical prompts.
Sarah: I'll add a dashboard tile and an alert: if `parse_errors > 0.5%` over 30m -> auto-rollback.
Maya: Timeline — we need SDK PRs, routing rule, canary config. Who owns SDK rollouts?
Ashwin: SDK PRs: Luke (web), Kevin (mobile), Nora (python). Target EOD tomorrow for SDK patches.
Kevin: Mobile PR up (WIP) — adds `so:opt_in` flag. Link: <private-pr-link>. Needs a quick review.
Ashwin: Reviewing now, will ping if anything blocks.
Maya: If a client claims opt-in but we see parse-error spikes, should we fallback automatically to compat=false for that client id?
Sarah: Yes — add fallback: if parse_errors per-client > 1% in last 5m -> route compat=false for that client for 10m and alert on the dashboard.
Nora: Note: we need a small durable state in routing service for per-client temp blacklisting. I can add that (couple hours).
Deploy-bot: canary-run: `so-compat-routing` | audience 5% web,2% backend | metrics: latency: no regressions; parse_errors=0.02% | 1918206600
Maya: Nice. Please also add a short blurb in rollout docs so people know the exact flags and guardrails.
Ashwin: I'll draft a 1-pager in product/rollouts and link to SDK PRs later today.
Maya: Thanks — I'll assemble a final go/no-go checklist after SDKs land.
